translation_notes: OWL_NS = Namespace('http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#') absorbed into '@prefix owl: <...> .'; OWL_NS.sameAs -> owl:sameAs, and each graph.add((s, p, o)) -> 'self.graph += g{ {self.identifier} owl:sameAs {classOrIdentifier(term)} }'
the mechanical draft named the prefix after the Python variable (owl-ns:); a hyphen is not a Python identifier character, so that prefix would only have worked inside g{} islands -- renamed to owl:
the object stays an interpolation, {classOrIdentifier(term)}: the term is computed by a helper, which is exactly the case the notation absorbs with {expr} rather than eliminating

context shim: infixowl_shim re-exports Individual and classOrIdentifier from rdflib.extras.infixowl (rdflib 7.2.1), the maintained descendant of the vendored rdflib 3.x copy the region comes from -- the vendored copy imports rdflib.py3compat and no longer loads; imported identically by both sides
import shim: 'from rdflib import Namespace' added to original.py (the extract used Namespace without importing it); kept in translated.ldpy for symmetry although @prefix makes it unused
'self.graph += g{...}' rebinds the attribute (Graph.__iadd__ returns self) where the original called self.graph.add(...) in place; observationally identical here
